name: I-1 Never-Lose-Work Fix
goal: Stop two active finalizer branches from silently destroying a push-pending obligation, add a structural backstop, ship as v1.1.7.

tasks.name: Active-branch preservation fix + tests
tasks.description: finalizeReconcile active branch gains the decodePushDisposition guard (return integrated-local before recycle); finalizeDirectAuthority /commit branch delegates to finishLocalIntegration. Two falsifiable RED tests first, placed in describe('reconcile') (core region run by integration-core.test.ts).

steps.description: RED test in describe('reconcile') (~:315-413; setup template :316-320, assertion template :401-411): const s = setup(true); git(s.assignment.worktree_path,'commit','-m','work to reconcile'); const head = git(s.assignment.worktree_path,'rev-parse','HEAD'); UPDATE disposition to a valid integration-pending JSON (phase,frozenCommit:head,remoteName:'origin',remoteUrl:'file:///unused-in-active-preserve',destinationRef:'refs/heads/main',expectedRemoteOldOid:null); assert precondition active+integration-pending; authority=issueAndVerify(...,'reconcile',reconcileEvidence(s.assignment)); finalizeReconcile; assert state==='integrated-local', worktree exists, row integrated+push-pending, integration_records row present. Use the file-local git() helper (no worktreeHeadForTest). Do NOT advance root main (merge-base gate ~:753-756). Commit MUST precede issuance (reconcileEvidence reads live HEAD).

RED test: same block, /commit path, NO pre-commit (createExactCommit commits the staged tree; seeded frozenCommit inert): const s=setup(true); head=git(...,'rev-parse','HEAD'); UPDATE same integration-pending disposition; authority=issueAndVerify(...,'commit',commitEvidence(s.assignment)); finalizeDirectAuthority(...,'reviewed commit'); assert state==='integrated-local', worktree exists, row integrated+push-pending.
Run the two RED tests; verify FAIL (reconcile 'reconciled', /commit 'cleaned', disposition NULL, integration_records deleted). A 'No test files found' error = wrong target path.
steps.expected: Both tests run and FAIL: state reconciled/cleaned, disposition NULL.

steps.description: Implement reconcile active-branch guard (finalizeReconcile ~1144-1148): after finalizeLocalCommit, `if (decodePushDisposition(local.assignment.disposition)) return { state:'integrated-local', integratedCommit: local.integratedCommit, pushError:'Remote has not proved the exact integrated candidate' };` before recycleFinalized; else recycle + return {state:'reconciled',...}. Identical to the repair branch.

Implement /commit active-branch delegation (finalizeDirectAuthority ~1070-1073): replace the unconditional recycleFinalized + return {state:'cleaned'} with `return finishLocalIntegration(db, local);`.
Run the two tests; verify GREEN.
steps.expected: Both PASS: integrated-local, push-pending preserved, integration_records present, worktree present.
